QuestInfo.name: A Very Merry Maplemas
QuestInfo.0: Now that I have Little Suzy's Wishlist, I need to give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo.  I'm thinking I should give it to Maple Claws; I should go see her in Happyville.
QuestInfo.1: I can give Little Suzy's Wishlist to Maple Claws.  In doing so, she'll be counting on me to help me recover her presents for her this year.  All I have to do now is to give Maple Claws the list to cement my decision. Yes... it's going to be a very Merry Maplemas this year!
QuestInfo.2: I thought that Maplemas was the better holiday so I gave #bLittle Suzy's Wishlist#k to Maple Claws.  In return, she gave me a red #bMaplemas Hat#k that I can wear proudly to show my Maplemas Spirit!  Every time I help Maple Claws recover the presents stolen by monsters, she'll reward me; I'll now be able to redeem presents with her in batches of #b10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, or 100#k.  I'll get different rewards at different tiers; the more presents I bring at one time, the better the rewards!  I'll need to bring her presents appropriate to my level though.\r\nBringing Maple Claws more presents will also help me earn #bMaplemas Spirit#k!  If the total amount of #bMaplemas Spirit#k accumulated on my world beats out the total amount of #bVersalmas Cheer#k, Maple Claws will have a special something for me at the end of the event!

0.0:
I see that you've spoken to Suzy. How did her decision go?

#b#L0#She wants me to make the choice for her... and I think I like the old traditions the best. It's Maplemas for me!#l#k
#b#L1#She wants me to make the choice for her, but I think that Versalmas sounds like the more interesting holiday.#l
0.1: Well, if you are making a decision for both you and her, then you should be doubly sure. If you choose Maplemas, I will be counting on you to recover my stolen presents for me. Once you've decided however, you'll be able to turn in #b30 presents or more to me at a time#k, for even better rewards! Just a warning though, if you choose Maplemas as your holiday this year, I doubt O-Pongo will allow you to redeem presents with him anymore.\r\nThink on it, and return to me with #bLittle Suzy's Wishlist#k when you're sure that this is not just the right choice for Suzy, but also the right choice for you as well. Okay?

I hope you are making the right decision. Just so you know, if you are celebrating Versalmas this year, you will #enot be allowed to redeem presents with me#n. I would like every present I lost back in its original condition so every child can receive what they were supposed to receive. But good luck... I will not fault you for making that choice. Merry Maplemas!

1.0:
You're back! And you've decided to give Little Suzy's Wishlist to me?

#b#L0#Yes! Here's her Wishlist.#l#k
#b#L1#Ummm, sorry, Maple Claws... Let me think about it some more.#l
1.1: Excellent! I'm glad I can count on your help this year. Let me give you something to commemorate the choice you've made...

yes.0: Wear the hat proudly, and show off your Maplemas Spirit! Now you can bring me presents in batches #b30, 40, 60, or 90#k! Like I said before, you get different rewards at different tiers; and the more presents you bring at one time, the better the rewards! And if you bring me #b100 presents#k, I'll give you a #bMaplemas Tree#k of your very own!
yes.1: In addition, let's show O-Pongo the spirit of some friendly competition as well! For each #b10 presents#k you collect for me, I'll reward you with #b1 Star of Maplemas Spirit#k, in addition to your regular reward. So if you redeem 60 presents, you'll get your reward plus #b6 Stars of Maplemas Spirit#k! The more presents you return, the more Maplemas Spirit we'll create in this world.
yes.2: I'll make you a promise: if we create more #bMaplemas Spirit#k than #dVersalmas Cheer#k this year, I'll reward every player who has chosen Maplemas with #ba special reward#k at the event end! So gather as many of those presents for me, and hold on to those #bStars#k! Remember, I'm only giving this special reward if we create enough #bMaplemas Spirit#k so work hard!

0.1: Take your time! I'll be right here. But don't wait too long! Meow!

item.0: Hmmm, looks like you're ready join me, but didn't you say you needed to help Suzy make a choice? I can't be sure that you're sure unless you bring me #bLittle Suzy's Wishlist#k. I hope you haven't lost it!
